{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ahto City Provisional Company''' was a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]]-run vendor based on [[Ahto City/Legends|Ahto City]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. It operated prior to and during the [[Jedi Civil War]], offering supplies to both offworlders and the native Selkath.
